print('=== Presets ===')

    print(f\"  provider={cfg['provider']}, name={cfg['name']}\")

    print(f\"  adapter={cfg['adapter']}, interval={cfg.get('interval',120)}\")
    print(f\"  readiness={pr['readiness']}\")
    print()
" 2>&1
